scope: Landing header navigation (header bar and opened menu drawer) of the approved reference revision-r2-refined/landing-{he,en}.html vs the candidate /he and /en. Every override below is applied to the REFERENCE-derived expectation only; it never relaxes the matcher. Anything not listed here must match the reference (role sequence, sides, geometry) or the cell FAILS.

roles.logo: the link/element that wraps the brand image
roles.section: in-page section link (href=#<id>); identity = the anchor id
roles.language-switch: any visible control that moves to the other language/market: class lang-switch|tl-lang, href to the other locale route or landing file, an hreflang attribute, or the label EN/HE/English/Hebrew/Hebrew version/עברית/אנגלית
roles.sign-in: local auth entry without signup (href /dashboard?lang=..., label Sign in / כניסה)
roles.cta: the primary filled call to action (class land-cta|tl-cta, or href with signup=true)
roles.menu-toggle: button that opens the navigation drawer (aria-controls / *menu-toggle*)
roles.other: anything else - never expected; an 'other' item in the candidate header FAILS the sequence check

overrides.where: header bar and drawer, every viewport, HE and EN
overrides.candidateRule: the candidate must show ZERO language-switch items in the header bar and in the opened drawer (assertion headerNoLanguageSwitch / drawerNoLanguageSwitch). The reference item (a.lang-switch 'EN' / 'עברית', drawer 'English' / 'עברית') is dropped from the expected sequence and from the geometry comparison - nothing else is dropped.

geometry.note: Two frames: (1) the header's inner content box (nav box minus padding) - reference .land-nav, candidate .tl-nav - for item placement inside the bar; (2) the VIEWPORT edge (documentElement.clientWidth, scrollbar excluded) for the logo and the EN action group, so a different content column (centred max-width vs the reference's full bleed) fails. Sides: logo/sections by page half; action group by anchoring (EN reference edge, HE logo far right, links next to it, actions far left per NAV-OWNER-HE-LOGO-LINKS-ACTIONS-LEFT). No override exists for the column width.
